verdict.rationale: Bento lets users define failure-mode detectors and alert rules in plain English, which it compiles into trace queries. It also ships Agent Skills that load into coding agents to run the integration playbook. Natural-language control is documented only for these flows, not for operating the product in general (triage, run inspection and analytics are documented through the dashboard and CLI). Missing for 10: a general natural-language command interface across the product (e.g., asking questions about runs or triaging issues conversationally), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the plain-English signal and alert creation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe any failure mode in plain English — Bento trains a signal on your own traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your entire history
Write alerts in English. Bento groups fires into incidents and judges each one real or benign
Alerts are defined in plain natural language... Rules compile to trace queries and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook.
It installs Bento’s Agent Skills and hands the agent the full integration playbook
